description_en: Queries the whitelist configurations of a listener
description_zh: 查询监听的白名单配置
kebab_example: aliyun slb describe-listener-access-control-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --load-balancer-id lb-8vb86hxixo8lvsja80000 --listener-port 80 --listener-protocol https --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeListenerAccessControlAttribute

parameters.description_en:
The region where the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance is created.

You can query the region ID from the [Regions and zones](~~40654~~) list or by calling the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation.
parameters.description_zh:
负载均衡实例的地域。

您可以从[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)列表或通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)接口查询地域ID。

parameters.description_en:
The frontend port that is used by the CLB instance.

Valid values: **1 to 65535**.

取值：**1~65535**。

parameters.description_en:
The frontend protocol that is used by the CLB instance.

> This parameter is required if the same port is specified for listeners of different protocols.

> 相同端口存在不同协议监听时，此字段必填。
